_comment: SYNTHETIC, unlike its two siblings in this directory — hand-built to hold the arms the live
account does not currently produce. Every field shape here is legal per the app-server's own
JSON Schema (codex app-server generate-json-schema), which is where each was taken from.
no-duration     `windowDurationMins: null` — schema-legal. The window cannot be named, so it
must come back as a named unknown and NEVER be guessed from its position.
no-reset        `resetsAt: null` — schema-legal. A percentage with no reset instant is a
number nothing can validate; it must not be plotted or reported as a value.
reversed        primary is the five-hour window and secondary the weekly, as the live
`codex_bengalfox` bucket really is. Mapping primary -> five_hour would read
the weekly window as five-hourly on the bucket that bills our work.
limited         `rateLimitReachedType` set and 100% used — the state the Overseer must act on.
unknown-window  a duration matching no name this build knows (42 minutes). Named, not dropped,
and not plotted from its unvalidated percentage.
